entries.title: Export generated recipes as game menu codes
entries.summary: Copy any optimized recipe as a CRRCP1 code, or export the whole generated menu as a single CRMENU1 code for quicker entry in game.
entries.evidence: The code prefixes and payload fields follow the community-verified CRRCP1 and CRMENU1 format already used by the menu code reader. Verify imported dishes in game after an update.

changes.title: Recipe menu code export
items: Every generated candidate now has an Export as recipe code button that builds a single-dish CRRCP1 code with an editable name, station, price and servings.
The recipe checker's live mix can be exported the same way once the composition is valid.
A new Export full menu code button on the results section packs every distinct generated candidate into one CRMENU1 code, up to the game's twelve-dish limit.
The generated code is shown in a read-only field and copied with one click, so it can be pasted into the in-game menu importer or back into the menu code reader.

entries.title: Power, climate, business and trading tools
entries.summary: Electricity, cooling, power-station, cash-runway, rent and market calculators, planner heat and power estimates, a combined shopping list, a menu-code reader, and an FAQ troubleshooter.
entries.evidence: Power draw, heat, temperature, rent, solvency, wage, lease and price tables were checked against a current version of the game. Verify important results in game after an update.

changes.title: New power and climate tools
items: Estimate electricity bills from device, kitchen, survey and machine draw in running, idle and paused states.
Reference the regional power price curve between the published floor and ceiling, with the grid fuel mixes.
Plan room temperature, production slowdown and the air conditioners or heaters a room needs.
Compare coal, oil, hydro and wind generators, their fuel demand, operating margin and break-even price.
Gather a complete power-station build checklist from the power recipes.

changes.title: New business and property tools
items: Combine revenue, rent, wages and electricity into an operating margin and a cash runway.
Model wages, hiring and heat slowdown for hired crews.
Estimate rent, lease terms and building value, and check auction bids and seizure buy-backs, all in the Business & property tool.
Reference commodity base prices and category spreads for market trading.

changes.title: Factory planner and statistics
items: The planner now estimates machine heat, room temperature, cooling units and electricity cost for the machines it assigns.
Factory statistics show the same heat, cooling and power estimate alongside the bottleneck view.
Add a product straight from the planner to a combined shopping list and gather shared raw materials once.
Planner links to the logistics, resources and troubleshooting tools for sourcing external inputs.

changes.title: Crafting, logistics and restaurant updates
items: Plan several products at once in a combined crafting shopping list with shared batches and leftovers.
Blueprints now cover power equipment, fuels, cooling and construction supplies with categories and search.
Logistics combines hauling, storage and transport throughput; resources combines mining and a survey notebook, and now lists coal as a ground resource.
The recipe calculator embeds the menu code reader, and answers factory problems as an FAQ with structured data for search.
Recipe candidates now show an estimated ingredient cost for reference.

changes.title: Analytics & feature flags
items: The tools send privacy-conscious usage events to PostHog, alongside Vercel Web Analytics, so i can see which calculators help and improve them.
New tools can be rolled out or rolled back with PostHog feature flags; each defaults to on when PostHog is unavailable.
A footer notice explains the analytics. Recipe, factory and survey data still stay in your browser.

entries.title: More tools for factories and restaurants
entries.summary: New crafting and resource tools, easier recipe sharing, and more reliable factory plans.
entries.evidence: Restaurant, crafting, and equipment data was checked against a current version of the game. This is not a live connection; check important results in game after an update.

changes.title: New tools
items: Find ingredients and crafting instructions for all 249 products.
Calculate batches, materials, and leftovers for a complete crafting chain.
Compare storage options, calculate hauling trips, and estimate mining output.
Start a factory plan from a ready-made blueprint.

changes.title: Easier planning and sharing
items: Factory plans now include enough machines and ingredients for full-speed production.
Applying a plan keeps your owned machines and existing supplies unchanged.
Find restaurant recipes using only the ingredients you can get.
Save restaurants and recipes in your browser, share them, and download backups.
Preview shared factory blueprints before saving them.

changes.title: Fixes and updates
items: Crafting pages are easier to find through search and related recipe links.
Game data updates now live here, with links from every tool.
Improved headings, spacing, and checklists in the mining, storage, hauling, and blueprint guides.
